questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She is building a new house.

options.text: A new house is being built by her.
She had built a new house.
She has built a new house.
A new house has been built by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **A new house is being built by her. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject "**She**" performing the action "**building a new house**".
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object "**a new house**" the subject, and add a form of the verb "**to be**" and the past participle of the main verb "**built**".
 
• The agent "**her**" can be included using the preposition "**by**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**She had built a new house**" is in the past perfect tense, indicating an action completed before a certain point in the past. It does not match the present tense of the original sentence.
 
• "**She has built a new house**" is in the present perfect tense, indicating an action completed at some unspecified time before now. It does not match the simple present tense of the original sentence.
 
• "**A new house has been built by her**" is also in passive voice, but uses a present perfect tense instead of a present continuous tense. It is grammatically correct but does not match the exact wording of the original sentence.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up and named P, Q, R, S. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragrap**h.**

(S1) Today, the world has become a much smaller place, thanks to the adventures and miracles of science.

(P) We are slowly realising that the world is a single cooperative group.

(Q) Other religions have become forces with which we have to reckon, and we are seeking for ways and means by which we can live together in peace and harmony.

(R) Mingling of population is bringing about interchange of thought.

(S) Foreign nations have become our next-door neighbours.

(S6) We cannot have religious unity and peace so long as we assert that we are in possession of the light and all others are groping in the darkness.
questions.solution:

• Sentence **S **talks about the increased interconnectedness and global nature of the world.
 
• Sentence **R **talks about how the mingling of population leads to an interchange of thought, which is relevant to the topic.
 
• Sentence **P **talks about how the world is becoming a single cooperative group, which builds on the idea of the world becoming smaller.
 
• Sentence **Q **talks about the need for peace and harmony among different religions, which is a relevant topic in today's globalized world.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• (**Q, R, S, P**) starts with the need for peace and harmony among different religions, but the other sentences are not in a logical order.
